lines: Business Sister of Parvos voice lines.
These voice lines are affected by the weapon's element used to kill the Sister Candidate.
- "So you can slap, I slap harder."
- "I was stunning before, I admit it. But now... I'm a whole different kind of hot..."
- "I'm getting a reputation for giving people the cold shoulder."
- "You murdered me, but now I have that whole "harness the power of lightning" thing, so... it's not all bad."
- "I'm not entirely sure what *kind* of poison this is, but I did see one guy throw up so hard he pretty much inverted."
- "Crank those shields all you want, it won't make any difference to me."
- "Here's what's gonna happen. We're gonna fight, you'll try to outsmart me, I'll flood you with a ton of radiation, and watch you die from some kind of catastrophic metastasis."
- "My sisters don't like me that much because I get things done. You're next on my list."
- "You don't really think you can beat me, do you?"
- "Ah, the lout of the Lotus. Is today the day you push your luck too far?"
- "I like you! I have the most fun with idiots and mean people, and you're both."
- "Well, you tried killing me and look how that turned out. I guess you aren't the right tool for the job."
- "Get me numbers of the most humiliating ways to murder Tenno. Top five. Wait... you're not my assistant!"
- "You think anyone can be a Sister of Parvos? Uh-uh, no. Only the best of the best."
- Dialogue is randomly pulled from #Birth of Sister, #After Logging In, #Spawning, and #Taunts sections.

path: Navigating controlled sectors in the Star Chart
lines: - "I claim this system in the name of Me."
- "All forces! Claim this sector in the name of Parvos Granum! And the rest of the Corpus, of course."
- "While they kiss one hand I'll take with the other. This sector is now under my control."
- "Hey Vala honey, guess who got a sector? Don't hate me too much."

path: Completing a Mission on an affected Node
lines: - "I swear to the Void, if you were any dumber you'd be a mineral."
- "Boo hoo, wah wah. Is this all you have?"

path: After Revealing a Requiem Mod / Upgrade Rank of the Sister
lines: - "Ugh, you make this so hard to watch. Closer. Closer."
- "Please, *BORING*. Warmer. Closer. Over... no, no, not... UUUUGH."
- "If you intend to find me you'll need to do better than that."
- "Colder... colder.... HA! You actually believe me."
- "Bet you didn't think you were gonna bump into me today."
- "Oh honey, when you go up against the Sisterhood, you swim with sharks."
- "First rule of success: if you think things are going well, you've overlooked something. Hello?"
- "Kinda sucks that you only get experience after you need it, huh? Prepare for an experience."
- "I think we need to talk about your attitude."
- "Get ready to make the biggest mistake of your career."
- "Hey sweetie, guess what? By the time I'm done with you, you'll never form a consonant again."
- "By the time I'm done with you, you're gonna look like a normal person REFLECTED IN A PUDDLE!"
- "I think you should take some Me Time and drop dead."
- "Oh, Vala is going to be so livid when she hears it was me who took you out!"
- "This is really bad idea on your part."

path: After Health Bar Segment is depleted and Hound Self-Detonates
lines: - "Hound, detonate yourself. It'll be a mercy."

path: One Health Bar Left / After Attacking with Correct Requiem Mod
lines: - "Ha ha, yeah, you're about as funny as a broken ankle."
- "I know, me asking for mercy is totally hypocritical, and I hate hypocrites. But I am one, so I'm okay with that. Don't kill me!"
- "Well look who decided to take a dip in beautiful Lake Moron."
- "Y'know, when a smart person is on their deathbed... they find another bed. But not you. Ooooh no."
- "What were you thinking? The inside of your head must be nothing but strobe lights and circus music."
- "Aw. Sad. You get one life and spend it doing everything wrong. Tsk."
- "I can make a better opponent by stuffing Clem's pajamas with rags."
- "I'm not sure what's wrong with you, but it's getting worse."
- "You're about as convincing as someone who stars in their own commercials."
- "I know, I know. I know! Ahaha. Oh you. Thank you!"
- "I just want to thank everyone who helped me get here. Now that I've achieved this promotion, you're all fired, and I'm buying real friends."
- "Finally, I get what I'm owed. Ultimate power. Feels good and it looks good on me. Mm hm. Now. Down to business."
- "Yes. Yes! This is me, Sisters, how I was always meant to be. There's a new goddess atop the mountain, and you're looking at her. Go ahead. Touch me. I'm real."
- "Great. Now I have to order another one."
- "I'm going to do that to your favorite floof and make you watch!"
- "So the Hound finally earns its keep. About time."
- "What are you waiting for, Hound? Finish it off!"
- "Don't look at me, Hound. I'm not cleaning up after you."
- "I never knew the Orokin made dog chews."
- "Keep still, you useless Hound. I need to consume you."
- "Proud, Tenno? Forcing me to consume my own pet to stay alive?"
- "I don't think so. Until next time."
- "I literally will not be caught dead here. Leaving!"
- "You have not seen the last of me!"
- "Alright sweetee, you can have this one. We'll settle this another time."

path: After failing the mission due to fighting the Sister
lines: - "Well, I'd just found a new background image for my datapad."
- "Aw, who folded up like a little press flower?"
- "I'll just bet you've been waiting your whole life to screw up this bad."

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Why are you following me? What is your damage?"
- "Oh. It's that null-unit who looks like a Tenno only smaller. We meet again."
- "Well well. Look who turned up to play soldier."
- "Now? Call ahead, for Void's sake. Some of us have plans."
- "I should have blown your ship into confetti when I had the chance. Now I have to get my nails dirty."

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Why are there fighters that aren't even fighting yet? Do I need a chalkboard?"
- "Launch fighters! Why isn't there a button for that?"

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Crewship! Put yourself between me and them."
- "Huh. A Crewship I didn't know I had. Send it in."

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Gatecrashers, bring Mommy that ship. Launch ramsleds."

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Nobody gets in here without an invite, ugly."
- "Turn around. Get back on your little spaceship. And leave. Right now."

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
Arriving at the Sister of Parvos
lines: - "Well hey there, sweetee. Any last mucking words?"

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Don't touch what you can't afford, ya microcephalic trog."
- "I would kill for a cryotic cocktail right now."

path: Taking down the Sister of Parvos in Railjack
lines: - "Hey! Hey hey hey! This all costs money, you peasant!"
- "You're a LOSER! You'll always be a loser!"
- "What's the POINT of being part of a SISTERHOOD if they let you down!"
- "Wait. This is what you wanted the whole time? You know you could have just ASKED."
- "Void. I'll never live this down. Yeah, okay. Let's just... get outta here before someone sees us together."
- "Well. Alright. I assume the position comes with the usual ship, bonus scheme, and insurance plan. Yes? No? SERIOUSLY?"

path: When Converted Sister Assists the Player
lines: - "Here I am to perform my contractually-obligated butt-saving. Stand back pew pew whatever."
- "In trouble again, huh? It's a miracle you get anything done. Alright, who are we shooting?"
- "Alright look, I'll help you out this one time, but you're buying lunch."
- "Ok I'm here. Y'know, when I did this stuff for Parvos, there were incentives. You might wanna think about that."

path: When Converted Sister Assists the Player
lines: - "Still alive? Great, one more reason for my Sisters to never speak to me again. Later."
- "Problem solved. You're green, I'm outta here."
- "Alright, so I got a thing. Call me, and we'll do lunch. Except don't, and we won't."

path: When Converted Sister Assists the Player
lines: - "You know, I always thought when I went it’d be the usual way. My Sisters framing me in some elaborate plot, or replacing my breakfast cereal... with... a landmine."
- "I should really just kick your ass, but I'm absolutely starving. Hang five."
- "Gonna take a mo' to grab a few calories."
- "I'm not here to play hide and seek, you loser. Besides, I can smell you."
- "You know I can smell you, right? So stop playing cute and come out."
- "Oh, come on. One-on-one? That's hardly fair."
- "Sure, I'll fight you one-on-one if I left my brain in the closet. Not a chance, buddy."
- "That was my best Eximus! Falling back!"
- "Well, you cleared those goons out pretty quick. How about we talk about this, like adults?"
- "Look, I don't have any beef with you, not really. This was all Parvos's idea. You and me, we're just caught in the middle. Let's talk this out."
- "Ok, there was nothing in the mission brief about kids being here. Run. RUN!"
- "Is... is that... a child? Oh, no. Oh, no, no, no. (screams)
- "Oh, Void. So high. I'm... I'm gonna be sick..."
- "Whoa, we are... really high up. Everything's spinning. Whoa. Whoaaaa."
- "Hey... back off, you mutt! Hey! Hey! Hey! Hey! (screams)
- "Kubrow! Keep it away from me! Keep it away!"
- "Ugh, gross. Nature. It is so itchy!"
- "How can you people work like this... in space? How can you not feel... small? Insignificant? Like... like you're nothing!? (screams)
- "Was... did we just punctured something? Are we venting atmo? Are we depressurizing? I don't want to get spaced!"
- "Oh, thank Parvos. I was prepared to go up against a warframe... but kids? I can totally beat up a kid. Come here, you little squealer.."
- "Cute. The kids are playing soldier. Well, come on then, you little punk. Let's play."
- "Grineer. Grineer! Oh, buddies you and me have a score to settle. Die!"
- "Forget the Tenno. Grineer, kill the Grineer!"
- "Eww, Infested! Kill it, kill it, kill it, kill it!"
- "If you think I need backup to take you down, you're more delusional than I thought."
- "Boom. That's what you get if I think you're not giving one hundred and ten percent when it comes to protecting me. Anyone else feeling hesitant? No? Then get back to work."
- "Pow. And let that be a lesson for the rest of you! If I hear any of you questioning my orders, you're Kubrow food. Now face forward and keep firing!"
- "Oh, that's how you wanna play it? Fine. Gloves off."
- "Fire, fire burning bright. I'm gonna set your hair alight, or whatever you have that passes for hair."
- "What I like most about fire is that it takes whatever's bothering a girl and makes it like it never existed."
- "Hey, that critter over there has a pelt that will pair perfectly with a pink Virmink ammo belt. Sorry, can't pass this up. [Be right back.]"
- "Take five. Spotted a cute little something I can use to line an battle vest. Hey little fella, come here! Momma wants to turn you into a snood."
- "Whatever you claim your reasons for wanting to stop me are, I know you're just jealous. Look at this face. Anyone would be."
- "I'm the ideal mix of style and substance, baby. And you just wanna destroy what you can't have."
- "You're in line for a special makeover. Oh, you are gonna be so hot. Smokin'. Crispy."
- "So there was this one girl, and we convinced her to put her tongue on a power cell, and... she died! (laughs) And it was just the funniest thing ever, and... yeah. Wooo, electricity!"
